title: Armor of God
definition: The armor of God is the spiritual provision God gives believers to stand firm against evil through truth, righteousness, the Gospel, faith, salvation, Scripture, and prayer.
summary: God equips believers to stand firm in spiritual warfare.
christFocus: Jesus is the victorious Lord whose truth, righteousness, Gospel, salvation, Word, and intercession strengthen His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The armor of God is God's provision for standing firm in spiritual battle. Believers are not told to fight in their own strength, but to be strong in the Lord.

Each part of the armor points to God's truth and saving work: truth, righteousness, Gospel readiness, faith, salvation, the Word of God, and prayer. These are not magical objects but spiritual realities to be received and practiced.

The armor teaches believers that warfare is fought through faithful dependence, not fear. God equips His people to resist lies, accusations, temptation, and discouragement.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers often try to face spiritual pressure with willpower, emotion, or panic. The armor of God matters because it shows that God has provided what His people need to stand.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Put on the armor by living in truth, resting in Christ's righteousness, holding to the Gospel, exercising faith, remembering salvation, using Scripture, and praying continually.
